sources.name: Chamber of Deputies open data — 10th term
sources.publisher: Chamber of Deputies of the Parliament of the Czech Republic

coverage.note: Each run downloads the complete official open-data snapshots (votes, members, prints, sessions with agenda items, parliamentary documents, and the index of the stenographic record) for the 10th Chamber term, reads the summaries of the amendments presented in the second reading, the written amendments they list, and the stenographic record of the votes that can be on them, and then applies the requested date cutoff.

sources.attribution: Source: Chamber of Deputies of the Parliament of the Czech Republic; include processing date.

sources.name: Collection of Laws — government regulations and ministerial decrees
sources.publisher: Ministry of the Interior of the Czech Republic

coverage.note: Each run lists every act of the Collection of Laws promulgated since bootstrapFrom, act by act through the permanent law-context cache, and keeps the government regulations (nařízení vlády) and ministerial decrees (vyhlášky) adopted by the government or a ministry while a tracked government governed.

sources.attribution: Source: e-Sbírka, Ministry of the Interior of the Czech Republic; include processing date.

sources.name: Government resolutions — zVlády portal of the Government Office
sources.publisher: Government Office of the Czech Republic

coverage.note: Each run reads every government resolution from firstResolution, the first of the current government, to the last one held: from the permanent resolution cache, or one request at a time from the zVlády portal. A resolution that only approves a government proposal, opinion, or regulation is left out, found by its material's PID in the Chamber's eKLEP links and the eKLEP open data, read in every run.

sources.attribution: Source: Government Office of the Czech Republic, zVlády and eKLEP open data; include processing date.
